page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c48g1.12xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated instance hosted on KVM hypervisors. The instance provides 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.9 GHz, supported by 48 MB of L3 cache. It includes 310 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 6.46 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of dedicated VRAM. The server features 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and includes no onboard local storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system and data persistence.

Benchmark results show top-tier execution speed for language model inference. On 135M parameter models, the instance achieves 9711.08 tokens per second for prompt processing and 456.51 tokens per second during text generation. On 7B parameter models, prompt processing reaches 2509.43 tokens per second with generation at 90.44 tokens per second, placing it within the top 10 percent of tested cloud hardware for these workloads. High-throughput multi-threaded decompression with bzip3 achieves 230.87 GB/sec, and Passmark encryption tests register in the top 25 percent. General compute tasks, such as Geekbench multi-core (15234.0) and Passmark overall CPU score (47330.47), perform within median ranges.

The configuration pairs a single GPU accelerator with a substantial 48-core CPU and 310 GB host memory pool. This resource balance provides high host memory capacity relative to GPU VRAM, allowing large datasets to remain cached in system RAM during pipeline stages. However, the absence of local NVMe storage shifts IOPS boundaries to external block storage interfaces. The instance is suited for AI inference serving, computer vision processing, image and video transcoding pipelines, and data processing tasks requiring dedicated CPU cores alongside GPU acceleration.
